name: com.tl.unity
description: Tl 4 playback-model runtime for Unity ECS with Burst: playback buffers, library singleton, simulation systems, and generated system jobs. Compiles against Tl.Core netstandard2.1 (P3+). Editor authoring is P6.

samples.description: The Force track from five small files: a cube in a SubScene with a Playable Director and a Push timeline. Press Play and the cube is pushed along X. Includes the scene builder and a PlayMode test.
Runs the 600-step kind script on a Linux IL2CPP player and prints whether its hash equals the .NET hash.
Sums game-code Damage pulses with timeline hit pulses into one Health write and prints whether its hash equals the .NET hash.
The USING-ECS demo: a walker that runs, dashes and takes damage, a dummy that only takes damage, two cues and an exact rewind, as Burst ISystems, with an editor setup script and a PlayMode test.
Plays Tl timelines from a MonoBehaviour with no ECS: a managed host, a library loaded from game.bytes, and a Transform driven from FixedUpdate.
